lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Mr. Gourmand!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Bready!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I've got a delicious feast ready for you.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Come to the kitchen.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Okay!
Woohoo!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Also,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: today's dessert is

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: something that Bready invented herself.
Oh, so you made it personally, Bready?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I came up with the original recipe,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but Crust perfected it.
Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: So you ended up making it, Crust?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Was the recipe hard to follow?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: It was a bit time-consuming,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: but I think it's perfect for a special occasion like today.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: What about the taste?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: It's perfect.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Good!
Actually, I've been wondering something for a while.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: What's that?
Why don't you do much cooking yourself, Bready?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Because I can't guarantee how it'll come out.
Why not?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: When you cook, you have to continually taste it throughout,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but when I cook,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I end up being overwhelmed with my own emotions and stories from the taste testing.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: In order to avoid that, I cook without tasting what I'm making,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and I end up not being able to tell whether the finished product is any good or not.
I see.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: If Bready were to get in the kitchen,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: my job would be at risk!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: She knows exactly

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: what types of ingredients

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: will bring certain flavors to the forefront.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: She's capable of making far more delicious dishes than me.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'm not so sure about that...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Even this time, for example. She gave me five variations on the recipe.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Two of them were already good enough to be put on a restaurant menu,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: and the other three only needed minor tweaks to become perfect.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I don't know about that...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I prepared the one I felt was the most delicious of the five.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I bet you're dying to try it, aren't you, Mr. Gourmand?
I certainly am!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Well then,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: get yourself over to the Cooking Oil kitchen

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: and try the dish that Bready invented.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'll be there soon, you don't have to keep saying it!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe, Bready, you seem embarrassed.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: She gets like this whenever anyone pays her a compliment.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Anyway, see you soon.
Be there as fast as I can.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: See you.
